title: A live run moves on its own and starts at Score 0
description: A run begins with the snake moving on its own across the board and the score display reading exactly "Score 0".

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run (use the start control if there is one). Then watch the board without touching any key and look at the score display.
success: The snake was visibly moving on its own across the play area, without any key held
